mechanism: Mexiletine may inhibit CYP3A4 and other hepatic enzymes involved in levonorgestrel metabolism, potentially increasing levonorgestrel exposure and oral contraceptive efficacy while also increasing adverse effect risk.
action: Monitor for signs of levonorgestrel toxicity (nausea, headache, breast tenderness); consider alternative antiarrhythmic if possible or ensure adequate contraceptive backup; counsel patient on potential for reduced contraceptive reliability if enzyme induction occurs.
